mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (username, password, email, phone, hometown_region_code, hometown_region_name, signature, avatar, role, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{hometownRegionCode}, #{hometownRegionName}, #{signature}, #{avatar}, #{role}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET username = #{username}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, hometown_region_code = #{hometownRegionCode}, hometown_region_name = #{hometownRegionName}, signature = #{signature}, avatar = #{avatar}, role = #{role}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user SET password = #{password}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
